message:
test(safety): fatal_exception deletes nothing recursively, binds loopback with its own LOCALAPPDATA, says what each case is (test-injection-finding r5, Codex 92f33ca SOURCE F1-F4)

- F1: no recursive delete at all -- the files this test writes, by name, one by one, then the folders it made only
  if empty; a failed delete counts as FAIL; a folder that is not empty stays (NOTE). The hosts' LOCALAPPDATA
  folders (their diagnostics) are not removed -- they stay inside the test root.
- F2: "none" is the NORMAL control (a plain 3 s start, no fault), not an early fault; no client of this test
  connects to any host here ("this test opens no socket" -- not "no connection is possible").
- F3: every host is bound to 127.0.0.1 on ports nobody holds (run() had no --bind-address and no port: the product
  port on every interface); the --prelogin worker through its test seam (GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_BIND_ADDRESS/PORT/SECONDS);
  each with LOCALAPPDATA in this run's folder (e2e_isolated_environment), not the user's.
- F4: every launch carries --host-power-management off (6b9cf79 for all three paths); run_with_client's gate needs
  the whole power line; the no-client cases (std, winrt, none, the worker) are zero by main()'s order (the policy is
  bound before HostPowerKeepalive exists, OFF requests nothing) and their own "host power management=off" line is
  checked afterwards as the record.

Built; not run.
